fields.name: Virtual compound key
fields.definition: A record identity formed by combining the shard id of the shard that holds a record with the record's own key of one to four columns. The combination is unique across a shard set even though each database assigns its keys independently, and it carries the information needed to route a request to the right shard. It is "virtual" because no database stores or enforces it as one key. ShardKey is ArgentSea's implementation.
